name: @castellan/rust-dispatch
description: Turbo package for the castellan-dispatch Cargo crate: per-crate nextest and clippy so `turbo run test/lint --affected` can select the changed crates and their dependents. Workspace-wide Cargo invocations stay on @castellan/rust.

scripts.lint: pixi run cargo clippy -p castellan-dispatch --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pixi run cargo nextest run -p castellan-dispatch && pixi run cargo test --doc -p castellan-dispatch
